tools.name: resolve_place
tools.description: Returns the lat/lon box for a neighborhood, street, or rough area such as downtown, with a suggested short incident query for get_city_crimes. get_area_trends accepts the place name directly.

tools.name: get_area_trends
tools.description: Summarizes incidents inside a neighborhood or rough area: counts by crime type compared with the city, counts by month, the noon-to-midnight share, top streets, and a few notable incidents. Takes a place name, such as Harbor View in Milwaukee, or a lat/lon box, and covers up to 450 days in one call.

tools.name: get_city_crimes
tools.description: Returns one page of individual incidents in a city, filtered by crime type, location type, dates, text, and an optional lat/lon box. Supports limit/offset pagination. A window longer than 45 days needs a geographic filter: the box, place, or location_descriptions. Chicago's portal withholds about th

tools.name: get_crime_stats
tools.description: Returns citywide counts, the date range, top crime types, and top location types for one city or all cities. The figures cover whole cities; get_area_trends covers a neighborhood.

tools.name: search_crimes
tools.description: Searches crime types and descriptions in one city or all cities and returns matching incidents. Matches come from incident text, which rarely names a neighborhood; get_area_trends covers places.
